classifiedBy: visual review of the supplied Phase 1B images (Claude Code session, 2026-10-30)

outfitVariants.A-corset-harness: Fitted camo corset with rose print and copper O-ring front, banded leather forearm cuffs with copper plates, heavy chain/pouch hip harness with octagonal copper frames, rose-print cargo pants, laced platform boots. No hood.
outfitVariants.B-wire-cage-hood: Camo crop top with sheer camo sleeves, copper wire-cage forearm armour with crystal drops, looser draped cargo pants with sweeping copper wire, chunkier sneaker-boots, optional camo hood. Signature pendant with two rose-quartz spheres.

images.intendedUse: Full-body front of outfit A; silhouette, proportions and texture reference for outfit A.
images.notes: Relaxed stance, arms slightly away from body, not a true A-pose. Dense dangling chains will read as fused geometry in a single-image reconstruction.

images.intendedUse: Waist belt, hip harness, pouches, octagonal copper frames, crystal drops, rose-print fabric.
Platform boot construction: lacing, buckled straps, copper toe/heel plates, crystal chains, rose-camo leather, cleated sole.

Cargo pant construction, layered straps, pouches, cuffing at the ankle, boot fit.

LÉLU signature pendant: twisted rose-gold frame holding two rose-quartz spheres, faceted rose-quartz drop, caged crystal side drops.
images.notes: Isolated object on dark ground; suitable for a separate image-to-3d accessory job later.

preserve.faceShape: Oval face, high defined cheekbones, softly tapered jaw and rounded chin.
preserve.eyes: Almond-shaped warm brown eyes, slightly upturned outer corners, winged liner, long dense lashes, moderate spacing.
preserve.brows: Full, dark, softly arched brows with a clean tail.
preserve.nose: Straight bridge, softly rounded tip, moderately full alae.
preserve.lips: Full lips, defined cupid's bow, fuller lower lip, glossy deep berry-brown colour.
preserve.skin: Deep warm brown complexion with a soft sheen; light freckles across cheeks and nose.
preserve.markings: Small star marks high on the cheekbones; dark swirl/curl markings at the forehead and temples; rose-quartz jewel at the hairline centre with a small crystal drop between the brows.
preserve.piercings: Septum ring; centred lower-lip (labret) stud with small drop; large rose-gold hoop earrings.
preserve.tattoos: Ornamental filigree across collarbones and chest; rose and filigree tattoos on hands and forearms.
preserve.hairline: Centre part; dense black corkscrew curls framing the face, pink/magenta highlights.

identity.rule: Identity references change only through an explicit, approved relock. Generated images are never promoted to identity references automatically.

coverageGaps: No right-side profile in either variant.

Outfit A has no A-pose, side or three-quarter view; outfit B has no unhooded side or three-quarter view.
No neutral-expression or open-mouth face reference for facial rigging and visemes.
